audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer states five times that Smoke Screen BLINDS — 'blind your passive autos', 'he blinds your passive-marked autos', 'smoke blind', 'his blind can't save him'. Smoke Screen does not blind. Riot's text: it 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' A player who believes his autos are blinded will hold a trade he could have won. Separately, the full layer never gives Quickdraw's cooldown and never mentions the property that actually makes it hard to track: hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers its cooldown and refreshes the resistance boost.
audit.why: Sight reduction and a blind are different problems with different answers — you can still auto through smoke, you just cannot see him. And 'engage when Quickdraw is down' is unreliable advice unless the player knows his autos are refunding it, which is why baiting it during a committed trade beats waiting on a timer.
audit.corrected: Blind removed everywhere it changes the advice; Smoke Screen restated as the sight cut plus impact slow. Quickdraw given 16/15/14/13/12s plus the auto-attack cooldown refund and the armour/MR stacking in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, tldr and winCon.

notes: The load-bearing correction: the content layer claimed five times that Smoke Screen BLINDS. Second correction: Quickdraw's cooldown is refunded by his basic attacks, so the page's repeated 'engage on Quickdraw's cooldown' is only reliable as 'engage once he has spent it' — rewritten that way.
